quarterly_data.quarter: Nokia press release: Nokia Corporation Interim Report for Q3 2026 (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 interim report (CEO Justin Hotard): Nokia expects its combined Optical and IP Networks businesses to grow between 25% and 30% in 2027. 2026 outlook assumptions updated: combined Optical and IP Networks now expected to grow somewhat above the prior 18-20% assumption within Network Infrastructure growth of 12-14%; full-year comparable operating profit outlook of EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 2.6 billion unchanged (based on EUR:USD 1.14 for the rest of 2026), with Q4 net sales assumed up 20% to 24% q-o-q and full-year operating profit above the mid-point of the outlook; comparable income tax rate ~26%; restructuring and associated charges raised to EUR 1 100 million, with cash outflows of EUR 800 - 900 million; comparable financial income and expenses positive EUR 300 to 400 million on strong venture-fund income. AI & Cloud order intake grew 118% year over year, and the Infinera integration is on track to complete by the end of 2026, one year ahead of plan, with EUR 200 million of net synergies.
quarterly_data.figure: combined Optical and IP Networks growth of 25%-30% expected in 2027

quarterly_data.quarter: Nokia press release: Nokia Corporation Interim Report for Q3 2026 (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supply (Q3 2026 interim report): Nokia is now planning to invest an additional EUR 400 million in working capital in 2026 to secure supply and support the growth opportunity in 2027, lowering its free cash flow conversion assumption to 35% to 55%; the 2026 capex assumption of EUR 750 - 850 million is reduced partly because the timing of some cash payments for manufacturing investments moves to 2027, while its optical manufacturing expansion plans remain on track.
quarterly_data.figure: additional EUR 400 million of working capital in 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: Nokia press release: Nokia Corporation Interim Report for Q3 2026 (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 reported results (interim report): reported gross margin 42.2% (down 220bps) and reported operating margin 3.8% (down 160bps) on accelerated restructuring and integration cost, against comparable operating margin of 11.7%; reported diluted EPS from continuing operations EUR 0.03. Segment operating margins: Network Infrastructure 10.0% (7.7% a year earlier; gross margin 41.2%), Mobile Infrastructure 14.5% (12.9%), helped in part by revenue accelerating from Q4 into Q3. Nine-month comparable operating profit EUR 1 340 million, up 31%. CEO: together with T-Mobile and NVIDIA, Nokia completed what it calls the world's first AI-RAN call in a live operator network.
quarterly_data.figure: Network Infrastructure operating margin 10.0%; Mobile Infrastructure 14.5%; reported operating margin 3.8%
